# Mirror lockstep drift register (ADR-0152 dual-support)
#
# One row per line: <v4-module> <side> <symbol> <reason...>
#   side=v4: symbol exists only on the v4 side — transition lag, or a
#            never-mirror verdict for surface that dies at the v5 cut.
#   side=v5: symbol exists only on the core/v5 side — deliberate v5
#            evolution (the audit trail for divergence decisions).
# A trailing "/..." on <symbol> covers a whole subpackage subtree.
#
# Enforced by TestMirrorLockstep in cmd/api-stability/mirror_lockstep_test.go:
# any drift NOT classified here fails CI, and rows that no longer cover any
# drift fail as stale — prune them when the sides reconverge. The per-pair
# lag/evolved counts in the test log are the v4→v5 migration ratchet.

event v4 v4/eventtest/... pending-mirror: eventtest suite not yet forked into core/v5/event (ADR-0152 transition lag)
event v4 func MarkInDelivery pending-mirror: delivery-mark feature not yet forked into core/v5/event
event v4 func WithoutDeliveryMark pending-mirror: delivery-mark feature not yet forked into core/v5/event
